UADataType.Description: A sample of a pump: its speed, whether it runs, a label, its speed range and the last few speeds.

UAObjectType.Description: A pump: status is the run command, motorRpm the measured motor speed.

UAObject.Description: Write status to command the pump; motorRpm is its measured motor speed, in rpm.

UAVariable.Description: Run command: on starts the motor.

UAObject.Description: Explicit object without a type - the counter tag lives here.
Variables of types the pumps have none of, for the gateway's suites.

UAVariable.Description: A PumpSampleType, written by the server after the load.

UAMethod.Description: Converts a motor speed in rpm to its frequency in Hz, and spells it.
Raises an event from this pump with the message and severity given, and the pump's rpm as its Rpm field.

uax:Description.uax:Text: The EventId the event was raised with.

UAObject.Description: The pump's alarm condition: active while motorRpm is over HighLimit, or when raised by Raise.

UAVariable.Description: The motorRpm over which the condition goes active, and at or under which it clears.

UAMethod.Description: Drives the condition by hand: active with the severity and message given, or inactive.

uax:Description.uax:Text: true raises the condition, false clears it.
The EventId of the transition's event, which Acknowledge and Confirm take.
